Class StationAnimation

java.lang.Object
common.animation.StationAnimation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Animation, JobContainer
public class StationAnimation extends Object implements Animation, JobContainer
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: orsotronIII Date: 17-gen-2005 Time: 13.56.04 This class provides a representation for a service station. No animation is provided by default. Implementing classes must override refresh method to implement and customize animation and job management.

  • Constructor Details

    • StationAnimation

      public StationAnimation(String type, Rectangle bounds, long residencetime)
      Creates a new instance of a station animation and initializes it with given type, (which can be source, server, delay, terminal, sink, fork, join), bounding box to set the area the rendered image must fill, and the number of millisecs an entering job must stay into this station during animation.
      Parameters:
      type - : type of this station
      bounds - : bounding box for this station
      residencetime - : number of millisecs an entering job must stay in this station

    • StationAnimation

      public StationAnimation(String type, Rectangle bounds, long residencetime, IconsToolkit toolkit)
      Creates a new instance of a station animation and initializes it with given type, (which can be source, server, delay, terminal, sink, fork, join), bounding box to set the area the rendered image must fill, and the number of millisecs an entering job must stay into this station during animation.
      Parameters:
      type - : type of this station
      bounds - : bounding box for this station
      residencetime - : number of millisecs an entering job must stay in this station
      toolkit - : image toolkit for customized renderization of this station.

  • Method Details

    • refresh

      public void refresh()
      Refreshes current settings for animation. An extending class should override this method to implement a customized animation. This method also implements job treatement, so that overriding method must implement job routing or recall this method.
      Specified by:
      refresh in interface Animation
